Raw MiniRocket is untouched. PPV is algebraically invariant to S>0 because convolution and fit quantile biases both scale; a binary power of two only shifts the float32 exponent for normal numbers, so bit-identity is plausible but unproven. S must be justified on synthetic near-threshold and near-overflow rows, not on the two failing datasets. Finite checks belong before and after the multiply. Do not restretch per row, clip, drop rows, or silence the guard.
